This competition only features Big Cubes and Blindfolded events. This competition may not be recommended for first-time competitors as it will not be a traditional competition and does not include the normal 3x3x3 Cube. Please consider instead any of the [other competitions happening in the area.](https://www.midwestcubing.org/upcoming-competitions)
